messages:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — need to lock Q2 roadmap prioritization before sprint planning tomorrow. Proposing RICE for top-level ordering then slice scope. Main candidates: Dedicated autoscale, Private telemetry + KMS, Optimize batching (SDK), Quantization recommendations UI. Comments?

Matt (Eng): RICE is fine but we should factor in revenue-opportunity too. Autoscale = high impact but big infra lift. Any rough R/I/C/E guesses to start?

Jordan (ML): From ML POV quantization UI + recommendations is low effort, decent impact. Quick RICE calc draft: R=6 I=4 C=5 E=2 => (6*4*5)/2 = 60.

Priya (Infra): Autoscale is infra-heavy — needs routing + safety canaries + metrics pipelines. Realistically 2 sprints minimum from infra team. We're down one senior this sprint and SRE oncall load is high.

Carlos (ProdOps): Note: 3 enterprise customers explicitly asked for private telemetry + KMS and are willing to pay for early access. That ups 'C' for telemetry.

Anya (PM): Concrete trade: (A) Push autoscale (long runway but big savings), (B) Telemetry+KMS (faster, billable), (C) Quant UI + batching (quick wins). My sequencing preference: B -> C -> A. Thoughts?

Matt (Eng): +1 B->C->A. We can ship telemetry as managed-hosted first to accelerate revenue, then add private KMS for those customers. For autoscale, consider hiring a contractor for infra spikes.

Priya (Infra): Contractor helps but ramp is ~2 weeks. Alternative: scope autoscale MVP to per-customer simple policy + opt-in flag to avoid kernel/kernel-scheduler work. That reduces estimated effort.

Jordan (ML): If autoscale MVP avoids kernel-level scheduling changes and focuses on per-tenant policy we can skip ML runtime changes. Cuts effort ~40% in my estimate.

Anya (PM): Decision proposal: 1) Prioritize B (telemetry + KMS early access) first, 2) Move C (quant UI + batching) in parallel with small cross-functional team, 3) Start A (autoscale) as scoped MVP and use contractor for infra-heavy tasks. I'll update JIRA and attach RICE scores. @Matt can you post updated capacity matrix?

Matt (Eng): Will post capacity matrix + who is oncall/blocked in ~2h. Also adding quick RICE helper I used:

``
# quick RICE example
Reach = 8
Impact = 5
Confidence = 60% -> 0.6
Effort (person-months) = 2
Score = (8 * 5 * 0.6) / 2 = 12
``

(we'll normalize confidence vs the simple 1-10 in the doc) :thumbsup:

Priya (Infra): Adding risk note: autoscale depends on eng-ml for KV cache safety and on eng-runtime for batching semantics. Marking tickets as blocked until we confirm those owners.

Jordan (ML): I can dedicate 2 days next sprint to unblock KV cache checks. Add me to the ticket and I'll prioritize.

Anya (PM): I'll draft launch criteria for telemetry/KMS early access: 1) ingestion + 30d retention, 2) KMS integration with audit logs, 3) private flag + docs for beta customers, 4) perf regression <5% on p95/p99. Sharing for review in the ticket.

Carlos (ProdOps): I'll coordinate with the 3 enterprise beta customers and set expectations + billing.

Matt (Eng): Posting capacity matrix link: https://placeholder.redwood/q2-capacity (will annotate blocked folks).

Anya (PM): Thanks all. I'll also add a short decision note in the roadmap doc: prioritize billable telemetry to reduce backlog pressure and buy time for autoscale infra work.
